method: SEED for U5 (in-tournament player form). wc_goals/wc_assists are FACTUAL from data/manual/results.json match notes + cross-checked golden-boot trackers (NBC + FOX + planetfootball + per-match Wikipedia) through MD2 (matches 1-48) and MD3-day-1 (M49-54, Jun 24). wc_minutes are best-estimate from start/sub timing. wc_xg/wc_xa/wc_shots are CONSERVATIVE ESTIMATES (~goals discounted toward process) unless a tracker published a value (a few xG are real, labelled). Most owned-player teams have NOT played their MD3 game yet (M61-72 are Jun 26-27), so their totals are through 2 games; Brazil (Vinicius/Cunha) + the other MD3-day-1 sides include their 3rd game. REFRESH each matchday (RUNBOOK §2): add real per-player WC xG/xA/shots + every fantasy-relevant performer, and keep the `teams` block (wc_xg_for/against) current. The model shrinks the club-season per-90 toward these, minutes-weighted (2-3 games barely move it), leaning on xG over goals so finishing heat regresses.

teams._note: U2 opponent-adjusted team form: per nation {wc_xg_for, wc_xg_against, matches, opponents} — tournament TOTALS (not per-game). FACTUAL goals-for/against drive the seed; xG values are goal-difference-consistent estimates (only a few players have tracker xG). The model credits xG-difference vs the strength of opponents faced (beating Curacao != beating France), shrunk by matches, as a SMALL post-calibration strength offset. Updated 2026-06-25: contenders now have 2-3 games; MD3-day-1 sides (Switzerland/Brazil/Morocco/Mexico/Bosnia + their opponents) include their 3rd game.
